concept: SQS FIFO: exactly-once and ordering via message group ID
tests: Knowing SQS FIFO guarantees: exactly-once processing and strict ordering within a message group.
expected: SQS FIFO with message group ID = account ID: ordering within an account and parallelism across accounts. Triggers: "exactly once", "in the order received", "per account".
why_not: SQS Standard is at-least-once with best-effort ordering; SNS Standard is pub/sub with no ordering guarantees; Kinesis with one shard orders globally but has no exactly-once and serializes all accounts.
